layer0_head0.given_name: Cell Cycle and Structural Regulation, Avoids Membrane Dynamics
layer0_head0.explanation: This head has increased attention on genes related to cell cycle progression, cytoskeleton organization, golgi apparatus components, and regulation of molecular function, while reducing attention to molecular transducer activity, membrane-related components and lipid metabolism, indicating a selective preference for internal cellular activities over membrane interactions.

layer4_head4.given_name: Reduces Cell Cycle & Protein Dynamics, Slight Lipid Metabolism Focus
layer4_head4.explanation: This head’s attention is negatively associated with cell cycle dynamics, protein metabolics, and slightly with signaling, phosphorylation and stress response while slightly increasing attention on lipid metabolic processes, indicating a specific regulation pattern focusing on metabolic activities over proliferative and stress-related signaling pathways.
